duration.text: The Management Science and Engineering at University of Electronic Science and Technology of China is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5138 USD/per year ￥ 37000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of postgraduate school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3 or above 6. Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents.

requirements.text: Two recommendation letters from persons with professional title of Associate Professor or above; In good health; under 45 years old.
